description: href="   " (blanks only) is non-empty: critical resolves it to the page itself, fetches the page HTML as a stylesheet, and the css parser turns that into an empty sheet (an extra empty join element).

thin.note: Proposal (not part of the decision list, confirm): a href that is blank after trimming is skipped and never fetched; fetching the page as a stylesheet would be rejected anyway (text/html). expected-thin.css = critical's output for the same page without the blank link.
